name: Mac OS X Aqua (2001)
framework: Mac OS X Aqua, early era (10.0 Cheetah – 10.2 Jaguar, Cocoa / Carbon)

elements.name: Alert
elements.doc: An application-modal alert: application icon at the left, bold message, small informative text, buttons at the right with the pulsing default button

elements.name: AlertSheet
elements.doc: An alert presented as a sheet (NSBeginAlertSheet): icon, message and buttons sliding from the title bar

elements.name: AppMenu
elements.doc: The application menu: the frontmost application's name in bold

elements.name: ApplicationIcon
elements.doc: An application icon: a glossy tile in the colour given by color:

elements.name: BevelButton
elements.doc: A square bevel button (NSRegularSquareBezelStyle) for icons and image wells

elements.name: Box
elements.doc: A group box: title above a sunken, slightly darker rounded box

elements.name: Browser
elements.doc: The column browser (NSBrowser), as in the Finder's column view: BrowserColumn children

elements.name: BrowserCell
elements.doc: A folder cell of a Browser column: icon, name and the black triangle at the right

elements.name: BrowserColumn
elements.doc: One column of a Browser: BrowserCell (folders, with the triangle) and FileCell rows

elements.name: Button
elements.doc: A push button: the clear gel lozenge. .variant(.default) is the pulsing blue default button

elements.name: CheckBox
elements.doc: An Aqua check box: clear gel square, blue gel with the check mark when on; checked: true | .mixed

elements.name: ColorWell
elements.doc: A row of colour wells / the Colors panel swatches

elements.name: ComboBox
elements.doc: A combo box: a text field with a blue gel arrow button at the right

elements.name: ContextMenu
elements.doc: A contextual menu drawn open in place: ContextMenu { MenuItem(…) }

elements.name: DefaultButton
elements.doc: The default button: blue gel, slowly pulsing; Return activates it

elements.name: Desktop
elements.doc: The Aqua desktop (blue wave). Put a MenuBar first, then windows, icons and the Dock placed with .position(x:y:)

elements.name: DiskIcon
elements.doc: A hard disk icon

elements.name: Dock
elements.doc: The Dock: a translucent shelf of DockItem icons with a DockSeparator before the Trash

elements.name: DockItem
elements.doc: An icon in the Dock: DockItem("Mail", icon: "envelope", color: .blue); .running() adds the black triangle, .highlighted() shows the name above

elements.name: DockSeparator
elements.doc: The separator between applications and documents/Trash in the Dock

elements.name: DocumentIcon
elements.doc: A document icon with the folded corner

elements.name: DocumentWindow
elements.doc: A document window (pinstriped, white content area)

elements.name: Drawer
elements.doc: A drawer sliding out of a window side (side: .trailing default, .leading); put it next to the Window in an HStack(spacing: 0)

elements.name: FileCell
elements.doc: A file cell of a Browser column (no triangle)

elements.name: FinderIcon
elements.doc: A Finder / desktop icon with its name below; icon: any icon name

elements.name: FolderIcon
elements.doc: A translucent blue Aqua folder

elements.name: HelpButton
elements.doc: The round help button with the question mark

elements.name: InfoBar
elements.doc: The Finder window status text under the toolbar: InfoBar("6 items", "2.4 GB available")

elements.name: LevelIndicator
elements.doc: A capacity indicator (as in the Finder's disk info)

elements.name: ListItem
elements.doc: A list row

elements.name: ListView
elements.doc: A white list (single-column table) with blue selection

elements.name: Matrix
elements.doc: NSMatrix of radio buttons (Interface Builder name)

elements.name: Menu
elements.doc: A menu; with no label it is a standalone (open) translucent menu

elements.name: MenuBar
elements.doc: The translucent menu bar: SystemMenu(), AppMenu("Finder"), MenuTitle("File") …, Spacer(), MenuExtra/Text(clock)

elements.name: MenuExtra
elements.doc: A menu extra (status item) at the right of the menu bar: MenuExtra(icon: "speaker") or MenuExtra("Mon 9:41 AM")

elements.name: MenuItem
elements.doc: A menu item: shortcut: "⌘N", checked:, icon:, .disabled(), .highlighted() for the blue gel item under the pointer

elements.name: MenuTitle
elements.doc: A menu bar title; MenuTitle("File", open: true) { MenuItem(…) } pulls its menu down

elements.name: MetalWindow
elements.doc: A brushed-metal (textured) window, as in the media and camera applications

elements.name: OutlineItem
elements.doc: A row of an OutlineView

elements.name: OutlineView
elements.doc: An outline view with disclosure triangles

elements.name: Panel
elements.doc: A utility panel (Fonts, Colors, Inspector): small title bar and small gel buttons

elements.name: PopUpButton
elements.doc: A pop-up button: clear gel lozenge with the blue cap holding the double arrows; items:, selection:, open:

elements.name: PreferenceIcon
elements.doc: A System Preferences pane icon: glossy tile (color:) with the glyph and its name below

elements.name: ProgressBar
elements.doc: Alias of ProgressIndicator

elements.name: ProgressIndicator
elements.doc: The Aqua progress bar: blue gel with moving barber stripes; no value: the indeterminate blue-and-white pole

elements.name: PullDownButton
elements.doc: A pull-down button: a gel lozenge with a single down arrow; open: true shows its menu

elements.name: PushButton
elements.doc: A push button (NSRoundedBezelStyle)

elements.name: RadioButton
elements.doc: An Aqua radio button: clear gel bead, blue with a dark dot when selected

elements.name: RadioGroup
elements.doc: A radio matrix: RadioGroup("Show:", items: [...], selection:)

elements.name: RoundButton
elements.doc: A round gel button (NSCircularBezelStyle); on a MetalWindow the transport buttons of a media player

elements.name: ScrollView
elements.doc: A scroll view with Aqua scroll bars: blue gel thumb, both arrows together at the bottom

elements.name: SearchField
elements.doc: A search field (rounded, with the magnifying glass)

elements.name: SecureTextField
elements.doc: A secure text field (bullets)

elements.name: SegmentedControl
elements.doc: A gel segmented control (items:, selection:)

elements.name: Separator
elements.doc: A separator line (NSBox separator)

elements.name: Sheet
elements.doc: A document-modal sheet sliding down from the title bar of the window drawn by the window chrome; buttons: [...], primary:

elements.name: Slider
elements.doc: An Aqua slider: thin gel track and the blue gel knob (pointed when ticks: is set)

elements.name: Spinner
elements.doc: The spinning (asynchronous) progress indicator with twelve grey spokes

elements.name: StatusDisplay
elements.doc: The LCD-style status display of a brushed-metal media application: title, subtitle and a progress

elements.name: Stepper
elements.doc: The little arrows (NSStepper) beside a number field

elements.name: StickyNote
elements.doc: A Stickies note

elements.name: SystemMenu
elements.doc: The system menu at the far left of the menu bar (drawn as a neutral blue gel orb); open: true shows its items

elements.name: TabView
elements.doc: An Aqua tab view: gel tab segments centred on the top edge of a sunken box; TabViewItem("General") { … } children
elements.sample: TabView(["One", "Two", "Three"]) { Text("First tab").tabItem { Text("One") }; Text("Second tab").tabItem { Text("Two") } }

elements.name: TabViewItem
elements.doc: One tab of a TabView
elements.sample: TabView { TabViewItem("Inbox") { Text("Inbox content") }; TabViewItem("Archive") { Text("Archive content") } }

elements.name: TableView
elements.doc: A table view: gel column headers (the sorted one in blue), alternating blue-white rows when variant: .alternating; columns:, rows:, sortColumn:, selectedRows:

elements.name: Terminal
elements.doc: A Terminal window (black on white, Monaco)

elements.name: TextField
elements.doc: A text field with the inset frame; .state(.focused) draws the blue focus ring

elements.name: TextView
elements.doc: A multi-line text view in an inset frame

elements.name: ToolTip
elements.doc: A help tag: pale yellow tooltip

elements.name: Toolbar
elements.doc: A window toolbar (NSToolbar): ToolbarButton items with large icons and labels below; the white toolbar toggle lozenge is drawn at the top right

elements.name: ToolbarButton
elements.doc: A toolbar item: ToolbarButton("Home", icon: "house")

elements.name: UtilityWindow
elements.doc: A utility window (NSPanel with the utility style)

elements.name: Window
elements.doc: An Aqua window: pinstriped body, title bar with the red/yellow/green gel buttons. .inactive() greys the buttons and title

elements.name: Board
elements.doc: Kanban board of BoardColumn children

elements.name: BoardColumn
elements.doc: BoardColumn("To do", count:, color:) { KanbanCard(…) }

elements.name: Callout
elements.doc: a numbered annotation; place with .position(x:y:)

elements.name: Canvas
elements.doc: free-form area; place children with .position(x:y:); grid: .dots|.lines

elements.name: Chart
elements.doc: kind: .bar|.line|.area|.pie|.donut|.scatter|.bubble|.radar|.heatmap|.funnel|.treemap|.gauge|.candlestick|.combo|.sparkline; values:/series:/labels:/points:/matrix:

elements.name: CodeEditor
elements.doc: CodeEditor("…", language: "swift", lineNumbers:, highlight: [3], tabs: [..])

elements.name: ColorSwatches
elements.doc: colors: [.red, "#0af", …], selection:

elements.name: Comment
elements.doc: author:, time:, avatar:

elements.name: DatePicker
elements.doc: selection: "2026-11-23"; .datePickerStyle(.graphical)

elements.name: Dialog
elements.sample: Dialog("Rename file", message: "Enter a new name for the report.", actions: { Button("Cancel"); Button("Rename") }) { TextField("Name", text: "Quarterly report") }

elements.name: EmptyState
elements.doc: title, systemImage:, description: { actions }

elements.name: Gantt
elements.doc: scale: ["W1",…], tasks: [("Design", 0, 2, 0.6), …], today:

elements.name: Grid
elements.doc: Grid of GridRow children, or columns: n

elements.name: HStack
elements.doc: Horizontal stack. spacing:, alignment: .top|.center|.bottom

elements.name: Image
elements.doc: Image("path.png") or Image(systemName: "star")

elements.name: KanbanCard
elements.doc: title, description:, tags: [..], assignees: [..], due:, comments:, priority:

elements.name: Kbd
elements.doc: Kbd(["⌘", "K"]) or Kbd("Esc")

elements.name: Label
elements.doc: Label("Inbox", systemImage: "tray")

elements.name: LazyVGrid
elements.doc: columns: [GridItem(.flexible()), …] or a count

elements.name: List
elements.doc: .listStyle(.insetGrouped|.plain|.sidebar|…)

elements.name: Map
elements.doc: pins: [(x%, y%, "label")], route:, showsUserLocation:, height:

elements.name: MessageBubble
elements.doc: MessageBubble("Hi", from: .me|.them, author:, time:, status:, reactions: [..])
elements.sample: MessageBubble("Running ten minutes late because the train stopped outside the station, so please start the meeting without me.", author: "Ana Lima", time: "09:41")

elements.name: NavigationSplitView
elements.doc: { sidebar } content: { … } detail: { … }

elements.name: NavigationStack
elements.doc: Content's .navigationTitle / .toolbar form the bar

elements.name: Picker
elements.doc: Picker("Size", selection: "M") { Text("S") … }

elements.name: Placeholder
elements.doc: A labelled box for maps, charts, media

elements.name: Pointer
elements.doc: Pointer(.arrow|.hand|.ibeam|.grab|.crosshair|.touch); place with .position

elements.name: ProgressView
elements.doc: value: 0…1 (or total:); none = indeterminate

elements.name: Row
elements.doc: title, subtitle:, detail:, systemImage:, chevron:

elements.name: Schedule
elements.doc: days: [..], startHour:, endHour:, events: [("Standup", "Mon", 9, 9.5, .blue)], now:

elements.name: Section
elements.doc: Section("Header") { … } footer: { … }

elements.name: SelectionRect
elements.doc: a drag-selection rectangle; size with .frame, place with .position

elements.name: Skeleton
elements.doc: lines:, avatar:, image:, shape: .circle|.rectangle|.text

elements.name: Spreadsheet
elements.doc: rows: [[…]], selection: "B2:C4", active:, formula:, sheets: [..], highlight: ["B3": .yellow]

elements.name: Stat
elements.doc: Stat("Revenue", "$48k", change: "+12%", trend: [..], systemImage:)

elements.name: Tab
elements.doc: Tab("Home", systemImage: "house") { … }

elements.name: Table
elements.doc: columns: ["Name", …], rows: [[…], …] or TableRow children

elements.name: Tabs
elements.sample: Tabs(["One", "Two", "Three"]) { Text("First tab").tabItem { Text("One") }; Text("Second tab").tabItem { Text("Two") } }

elements.name: Text
elements.doc: Text with **bold**, *italic*, `code` Markdown

elements.name: TimelineItem
elements.doc: title, time:, description:, systemImage:, status:

elements.name: Toast
elements.sample: Toast("Message sent", description: "Your reply reached 3 people.", action: "Undo", systemImage: "checkmark.circle")

elements.name: Toggle
elements.doc: Toggle("Wi-Fi", isOn: true)

elements.name: ToolbarItem
elements.doc: ToolbarItem(placement: .topBarTrailing) { … }

elements.name: Tooltip
elements.sample: Tooltip("Share a link to this page") { Button("Share", systemImage: "square.and.arrow.up") }

elements.name: Tree
elements.doc: Tree { TreeItem("src") { TreeItem("main.swift") } }

elements.name: TreeItem
elements.doc: label, systemImage:, folder:, expanded:, selected:, detail:

elements.name: VStack
elements.doc: Vertical stack. spacing:, alignment: .leading|.center|.trailing

elements.name: VideoPlayer
elements.doc: poster image, progress: 0…1, time:, duration:, playing:

elements.doc: Overlapping layers. alignment:
